description:
Blue Sky Plan 5 is open with a case loaded containing a single implant at site #36 (lower left first molar). The implant is currently placed vertically and at the crest level.

Your task is to modify this EXISTING implant's position to better fit the anatomy:
1. Select the implant at site #36.
2. Change the angulation: Tilt the implant approximately 10 degrees lingually (towards the tongue).
3. Change the depth: Move the implant 2mm deeper (apically) into the bone.
4. Verify the new position in the Cross-Sectional and 3D views.
5. Save the modified project (Ctrl+S).

Do not create a new implant. Modify the existing one.
